meta.description: SOPRO S Series smart lighting: 114+ no-main-light fittings in 8 categories, museum-grade healthy light, SPWM dimming and control by voice, sensors and MixPad.

sec3.desc:
Smart light

sec4.title:
Over 114 no-main-light fittings in 8 categories
for endless design ideas
sec5.title: Museum-grade, healthy light
sec5.info_title:
Six core optical standards
for museum-grade, healthy light
sec5.info_desc: We refined every optical measure, from glare, flicker and color rendering to blue light, lumen decay and light output, for healthy light that lifts body and mind.
sec5.card1:
3840 Hz ultra-high frequency
flicker-free comfort for your eyes
sec5.card2:
Sunlike spectrum
RG1, naturally low blue light
sec5.card3:
CRI up to Ra 90
as true as daylight
sec5.card4:
15% more lumens at the same power
for bright, airy rooms
sec5.card5:
UGR < 7.6 deep anti-glare
see the light, not the lamp
sec5.card6:
50,000 hours of steady, quality light
fine materials, made to last ten years
sec6.title: The right mood for every moment
sec6.title2:
10,000-level SPWM color temperature dimming across the range
the right mood for every moment
sec6.video_desc: Pulse-wave signals set the brightness and color temperature, so unsteady current won't cause flicker or color shift. Adjusting the pulse duty cycle changes the LEDs' average current, for smoother dimming and color tuning.
sec7.title: A 100 m² home that lives like 300 m²
sec7.video_desc: Instant smart scenes that bring your home to life
sec10.title:
MixPad smart dimming
light that changes as you wish, wherever you are
sec10.item_info:
Lights on by voice, instantly
no extra words needed
sec10.item_info2:
Classic buttons
even grandparents can use
sec10.item_info3:
Touchscreen light control
fine-tune the ambience
sec10.item_info4:
Remote control in the app
no more lights left on
sec11.title: The Butler, smarter than ever
sec11.subtitle: No wake word: just ask for light
sec11.desc:
The Butler is now smarter all round. Talk to it the way you talk to anyone:
however you put it, it gets the light exactly right.
sec13.title: Proactive, human-centric lighting
sec13.subtitle: AISense 3.0
sec13.desc: With ORVIBO's latest presence sensor, the system senses where you are and how you move in real time: the lights come on the moment you're there and fade out after you leave. Nothing to press: the light simply follows you.
sec13.slide_info2: Stays on while you're there, even when still
sec13.slide_info3: On as you arrive, off as you leave
sec13.slide_info4: Knows when you sleep and when you're up at night
sec14.title: Auto Lighting
sec14.subtitle: Proactive light tuning, all day long
sec14.desc: ORVIBO Home AI follows the sun's color temperature and brightness through all 24 hours, in step with your body's melatonin rhythm: cooler by day to help you focus, warmer at night to help you sleep deeply. It keeps a busy routine in balance and makes sleep easier.
sec15.title:
Saves energy on its own
and suggests the right light
sec16.title:
Rock-solid
in big villas
sec17.title: Five-star bespoke lighting design
sec17.desc: Professional design for a beautifully lit home
sec17.remind: 5% of your renovation budget, 95% of the effect
